description: Search the catalogue of 296 moving-image works by César Yagüe. Filter by collection, orientation (including ultrawide, 21:9 and wider), resolution, availability, price, free text — or by dominant colour, which is measured from every frame of the master rather than described; each result then says how much of the frame that colour covers on average across the whole loop, and for how much of the loop its colour family is present. A basic colour (blue, green…) counts its whole family of shades. Also by year, loop length in seconds, and whether a work may be rotated. Free text about flashes, strobing, epilepsy or photosensitivity returns the works with measured abrupt light events; catalog_overview lists every catalogue-wide fact (sound, text in the image, abrupt light events, near-black passages).

colour.description: Dominant colour by name (gold, teal, crimson…) or hex. Measured from every frame.

offset.description: Skip this many results, to read the next page

orientation.description: ultrawide = at least twice as wide as tall (21:9 and wider); landscape includes it

query.description: Free text across titles, descriptions and curatorial notes

resolution.description: The resolution label each work shows, matched exactly: HD, 4K, 5K, 8K, 10K, 12K, 16K; square works carry their own, such as 2K or 3K. An unknown label returns the list in use.

rotation.description: Whether the work must keep its orientation or may be rotated 90 degrees
